roleHints.super_admin: Full access to every section and setting.
roleHints.editor: Creates and edits items, submits them for review.
roleHints.archivist: Maintains the catalogue: funds, inventories, cases, documents and files.
roleHints.branch_admin: Manages the information of their own branch.
roleHints.analyst: Views statistics and reports, changes nothing.

workflow.title: Approval

next.draft: The item is not visible on the site. Next step: submit it for review. The author does this: an editor, an archivist or a branch administrator.
next.review: The item is waiting for review. A moderator approves it or returns it for changes with a comment.
next.needs_changes: The item was returned for changes and is not visible on the site. The author fixes the remarks and submits it again.
next.approved: The item is approved but not yet visible on the site. A moderator or an administrator can publish it.
next.published: The item is visible on the site. To change it, the author takes it off the site; after editing it goes through review again.
next.archived: The item is archived and not visible on the site. A moderator can restore it to drafts.

workflow.noActions: Your role has no actions at this step.
workflow.saveFirst: Save the form first: the action applies to the saved version.

done.submit: The item was submitted for review.
done.return: The item was returned for changes.
done.archive: The item was moved to the archive.
done.restore: The item was restored to drafts.

return.title: Return for changes?
return.text: The author gets a notification with your comment and fixes the item.

publish.title: Publish the item?
publish.text: The item becomes visible to all visitors. File access does not change: closed files stay closed.

archive.title: Move the item to the archive?
archive.text: The item disappears from the site. It can come back only as a draft that goes through approval again.

rework.title: Unpublish the item?
rework.text: The item disappears from the site until it is reviewed and published again.

comment.hint: A comment is required: the author sees it in the item card.
